title: Enhancing Mental Health Counseling Support in Bangladesh using Culturally-Grounded Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation of LLM-generated counseling responses using a 5-point Likert scale to assess 'wording' (including cultural appropriateness, tone, and local idioms of distress) and 'environmental analysis' (consideration of social environment), comparing standard retrieval-augmented generation against a culturally-grounded Knowledge Graph.

Human evaluation measuring the 'environmental analysis' of generated responses to determine if the models properly consider structural issues like economic precarity and poverty drivers, utilizing a Knowledge Graph that explicitly maps out poverty-related causal chains.
